96963.title: Lead of an Invoiced or Paid work order cannot be changed (release)
96963.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example Esther Howard) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example Ralph Edwards) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Invoiced Paid Locked") is used by this case only and has six work orders whose Lead Technician was set while they were still open (for example S10043-17801 to S10043-17806): {Work-order-1} Approved, led by {Technician-A}; {Work-order-2} Invoiced, led by {Technician-A}; {Work-order-3} Paid, led by {Technician-A}; {Work-order-4} Invoiced, with no lead technician; {Work-order-5} Declined, led by {Technician-A}; {Work-order-6} Complete, led by {Technician-A}.
  • {Technician-B} is not the technician on any line of these work orders.
  • No technician has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
96963.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View in the display switcher.
  2. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  3. Drag {Work-order-2}'s card from {Technician-A}'s column into {Technician-B}'s column.
  4. Drag {Work-order-2}'s card into the Unassigned column.
  5. Drag {Work-order-2}'s card within {Technician-A}'s column to above {Work-order-1}.
  6. Drag {Work-order-3}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column.
  7. Drag {Work-order-3}'s card into the Unassigned column.
  8. Drag {Work-order-3}'s card within {Technician-A}'s column to above {Work-order-1}.
  9. Drag {Work-order-4}'s card into {Technician-A}'s column.
  10. Drag {Work-order-4}'s card to a new place within the Unassigned column.
  11. Drag {Work-order-5}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column (click Keep shifts if asked).
  12. Drag {Work-order-6}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column (click Keep shifts if asked).
  13. Open {Work-order-2}.
  14. Try to change Lead Technician on the work order page.
  15. Go back to the Work Orders page.
  16. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  17. Do steps 3 to 10 again with the rows.
  18. Drag {Work-order-5}'s row from {Technician-B}'s group back into {Technician-A}'s group.
  19. Drag {Work-order-6}'s row from {Technician-B}'s group back into {Technician-A}'s group.
96963.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the All tab opens in Board View.
  • Step 2: only {Customer-A}'s six work orders show: {Work-order-1}, {Work-order-2}, {Work-order-3}, {Work-order-5} and {Work-order-6} in {Technician-A}'s column, and {Work-order-4} in the Unassigned column.
  • Steps 3, 4, 6 and 7: {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} cannot be moved to {Technician-B} or to Unassigned: the card goes back to {Technician-A}'s column and the lead stays {Technician-A}. While {Work-order-2}'s card is over {Technician-B}'s column, the note "Invoiced · can’t be reassigned" shows at the top of that column; for {Work-order-3} it reads "Paid · can’t be reassigned".
  • Steps 5 and 8: {Work-order-2} and {Work-order-3} can be moved within {Technician-A}'s column and keep their new place.
  • Steps 9 and 10: {Work-order-4} cannot be moved out of Unassigned, but it can be reordered inside it.
  • Steps 11 and 12: {Work-order-5} (Declined) and {Work-order-6} (Complete) move to {Technician-B} normally: each card now sits in {Technician-B}'s column.
  • Step 13: the work order page of {Work-order-2} opens.
  • Step 14: on the work order page the Lead Technician of {Work-order-2} cannot be changed either.
  • Step 15: the Work Orders page shows again.
  • Step 16: Tech View opens.
  • Steps 17 to 19: Tech View follows the same rules for every move (the note shows at the top of {Technician-B}'s group). A change sent outside the screens is also refused by the server; this part cannot be checked by hand, so write "server refusal not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see. Imported work orders are checked in their own case.

Release copy of C96963 (in the Fast-follow folder). It leaves out the messages shown after {Work-order-5} and {Work-order-6} move to {Technician-B}, which waits on SV-11522 / SV-11524: Chris Ward (product owner) made these fast-follows for after the release (Slack, 20 Oct 2026, https://shopview.slack.com/archives/C0C41RV3T3L/p1792455057423139).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R10, S4-N2, S4-N6 and Key decision: lead locked once Invoiced or Paid, read 19 Oct 2026. In version 48 (12 Oct 2026) S4-N2 dropped Imported from the locked statuses (Imported work orders now open in List only); the Invoiced and Paid rules this case checks are unchanged, so the expected results are unchanged. Review Decisions DR-37 (Declined and Complete move freely). PO answer to engineering, Sasha Grosman 24 Sep 2026 (Invoiced/Paid reorder within their technician or within Unassigned). In versions 66 to 68 (19 Oct 2026) the Invoiced or Paid rule was extended to Unassign and S4-N6 gave the drag note the design's words; the results of steps 3, 4, 6, 7 and 17 to 19 follow. Source-verified 19 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R10: “Enforce the prohibited-status rule in S4-N2 on every lead-change path, including requests that bypass interface controls.”
  • S4-N2: “Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced or Paid status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.”
  • S4-N6: “On an Invoiced or Paid work order the Assign lead technician or Reassign lead technician action (S3-R14) and the Unassign action are disabled, and their tooltip reads “Invoiced · can’t be reassigned” or “Paid · can’t be reassigned”, as in the design. The same words are the tooltip on the card’s or row’s lock icon, and the note shown at the top of another technician’s column or group while the work order is dragged over it, where the drop is refused.”
  • Key decision: lead locked once Invoiced or Paid: “Lead technician cannot be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid. This is a product rule, not only a screen rule, so it must hold on every path that changes the lead technician — board drag, the lead technician dialog, Unassign, Undo, and the work order detail page.”

AUTOMATION: READY
why: Left out: the "{Work-order-5} assigned to {Technician-B}" and "{Work-order-6} assigned to {Technician-B}" messages and their Undo button (old steps 8 and 9).
Removed the Known problem paragraph (SV-11524) and the S4-R5 quote (it backed only the messages).
Source paragraph: S4-R5 and the sentence about the new message dropped, "and Undo" dropped from the lock-rule history (Undo is the fast-follow part), step numbers renumbered.
Compound steps split into one action each (old 6, 7, 10 and 11): 11 steps -> 19 steps; the Tech View repeat now names steps 3 to 10.
Added plain results for the steps that had none (1, 2, 13, 15, 16); every result line starts with its step numbers.
Preconditions unchanged (every record is still used). AUTOMATION: READY (was READY - EXPECT FAIL (SV-11524)).

96973.title: Reassign lead technician dialog lists technicians outside the filter (release)
96973.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit. Your own staff record is also an eligible technician (Time Clock on, Role not Office User or Time Clock User, this location in Location), e.g. "Aaron Keating".
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Two other eligible technicians at this location: [Tech-A] "Ralph Edwards" and [Tech-B] "Dana Ortiz". A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Outside Filter" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] with Lead Technician = you ([User-A]); you are not its service advisor and no line is assigned to anyone but you.
  • Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz are named in the expected results and stay as written; the number is an example. What must hold: with the search below, Assigned to me shows only your column with 1 work order.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). Your own staff record must also be an eligible technician (Settings > Staff > your own row's edit icon > Time Clock on, Role not Office User or Time Clock User, with this location picked in Location), e.g. "Aaron Keating".
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] = "Ralph Edwards" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it), [Tech-B] = "Dana Ortiz" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Outside Filter" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Outside Filter": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Assign lead technician > click the technician; it is assigned at once.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): on the work order page set Lead Technician to yourself ([User-A]). Make sure you are not this work order's service advisor and no line is assigned to anyone but you.
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Outside Filter" shows [WO-1] with Lead Technician = you. If not, fix it on the work order page before starting; then clear the search.
96973.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View.
  2. Turn on Assigned to me.
  3. Click Search and type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Outside Filter".
  4. Write down which technician columns are shown.
  5. Hover the card, click More actions and choose Reassign lead technician.
  6. Read the technicians listed in the Reassign lead technician dialog.
96973.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the All tab opens in Board View.
  • Step 2: Assigned to me is on.
  • Steps 3 and 4: only your own column is shown, holding [WO-1]; the columns of Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz are not on screen.
  • Step 5: the Reassign lead technician dialog opens.
  • Step 6: The dialog offers Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz although their columns are not on screen under Assigned to me.

Release copy of C96973 (in the Fast-follow folder). It leaves out picking a technician in the dialog (it assigns at once, with no Reassign button) and the card then leaving the filtered board, which waits on SV-11522 / SV-11524: Chris Ward (product owner) made these fast-follows for after the release (Slack, 20 Oct 2026, https://shopview.slack.com/archives/C0C41RV3T3L/p1792455057423139).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-E4 and S3-N1, read 19 Oct 2026. Assigned to me behaviour S1-R13 / S3-N1. Source-verified 19 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-E4: “The lead technician dialog (Assign or Reassign) offers technicians outside the current filter.”
  • S3-N1: “With Assigned to me enabled, Board View shows only the technician columns, including Unassigned, that hold at least one work order matching Assigned to me (S1-R13). Every other column is hidden, including pinned technicians.”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

AUTOMATION: READY
why: Left out: clicking a technician in the dialog (old steps 6 and 7), the one-click assignment with no confirm button, and the card leaving the board with the empty-board message.
Removed the Known problem paragraph (SV-11522 / SV-11524) and the quotes S4-R13, S4-E8 and S1-N1a (they backed only removed results); kept S4-E4 and S3-N1.
Source paragraph: codes cut to S4-E4 and S3-N1; the 15 Oct note about the removed result dropped.
Step 1 split (Assigned to me is its own step); 7 steps -> 6 steps (old steps 6 and 7 left out).
Added plain results for each step; step 3/4 result backed by S3-N1 and by the precondition 'Assigned to me shows only your column with 1 work order'.

Kept on purpose: opening 'Reassign lead technician' on a work order that has a lead is today's release wording (SV-11522 changes the wording only for a work order with no lead, and the one-click choice/Unassigned row inside the dialog).

Preconditions unchanged; note: Setup step 5 still carries the Estimate hint 'More actions (…) > Assign lead technician > click the technician; it is assigned at once', which describes the fast-follow dialog but is not used here (the work order is Approved). Left as is (brief: same preconditions) and reported.

Record them as [Tech-A] = "Esther Howard" (use exactly this name: the expected results name it).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Remove Lead Prompt" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.

154889.custom_steps:

Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)


Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and Schedule access, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example Esther Howard) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on, the Service department, and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
